fixed_design: Four complete native route states, D64/r16, one masked single-head exchange at the second block's native normalized-input site. Q/K/V:D-by-r, U:r-by-D, no biases, route-index embedding or added dropout. Z_tilde=Z+softmax_row((ZQ)(ZK)^T/sqrt(r), diagonal masked)(ZV)U. Keep raw residual state, native graph/root block, four classifiers, ordinary mean-own TRAIN CE and declared final reducer. No location/rank/width/head search.
initial_function_preservation: U=0 gives Z_tilde=Z exactly. Bind identical base body/factors/optimizer initial tensors first; use a separate declared RNG stream for new-module initialization so native parameter initialization and paired dropout streams are not silently shifted. Deterministic evaluation function equals baseline at initialization; this is not a theorem about later learning or superiority. First Q/K/V gradient is zero; only U initially receives the task cotangent.
route_recipient_versus_graph_receiver: The attention recipient is a route slot m at the SAME node u. This is not an edge-specific gate conditioned on a receiving graph node v. The next unchanged native graph propagation sends each route's exchanged state across existing graph edges. In a linear native neighbor branch, P Z_tilde_m(v)=P Z_m(v)+sum_u P[v,u] sum_j a_mj(u) Z_j(u)VU. The node-dependent mixture generally cannot be moved through P unchanged. Root/nonlinear updates continue after this message. Final-only feature fusion would not change this next neighborhood message; no superiority over a capable late-fusion model is established by placement alone.
published_ancestry: Cross-stitch is the closest continuing-stream alternative; Set Transformer SAB is the standard nonlinear interaction primitive. HGEN/LHGEL/FFL/PCL/SAGMM already establish hidden fusion/joint training in other placements. Four same-input continuing outputs do not reproduce native independent-input MIMO. A flattened structured wider attention model represents this coupled forward, so no attention-primitive novelty or wider-model expressivity separation is claimed.
